lead_headline: AI SDK ships twenty releases in a single cycle on the back of a codebase-wide rename sweep
lead_body: Seventy-three PRs closed in one day, most of them a coordinated rename pass across Google, LangChain, workflow, MCP, devtools, and OpenAI packages — the documentation justifying the convention arrived after the code did. Three features also cleared: response.stream, the onAbort telemetry hook, and OpenAI Responses API query forwarding.
lead_article:
The day belonged to AI SDK, which put out twenty releases and closed seventy-three PRs in a single cycle — the bulk of them a coordinated rename sweep across Google, LangChain, workflow, MCP, devtools, and OpenAI packages, tightening local variable names throughout the codebase before the docs guidance that justified the change even landed. Alongside the hygiene work, three substantive features shipped: `response.stream` merged, giving callers a first-class stream handle off the result object; the `onAbort` hook arrived to close telemetry spans cleanly on cancellation; and the OpenAI provider now forwards `web_search_call.action.queries` from the Responses API. The Bedrock fix for document files in tool results also cleared, backported same-day.

Claude Code released v2.1.152 and immediately absorbed a wave of reports — ARM aarch64 Linux hangs on the native installer, arrow keys hijacked in the prompt input, the auto-updater rewriting `~/.local/bin/claude` as a self-referential symlink (a recurrence of a prior regression), and a Cowork FUSE mount serving stale inodes that silently corrupt git operations. The batch close at 22:45 swept out dozens of older issues, including the sub-agent permission escalation bug, the SessionStart hook race against the cron scheduler, and the Opus 4.7 effort-level setting being ignored on session start. Astro moved steadily: advanced routing lost its experimental flag, the markdown processor abstraction merged, Cloudflare fetch and Hono handlers for advanced routing landed, and the `astro dev --background` flag replaced the old subcommand form. Workflow SDK merged the `Promise.race([sleep, hook])` prefix determinism tests and opened a trace replay debug PR. Gemma.cpp was quiet — a copyright-year correction and a flash-attention link-error fix on multi-target SIMD builds.
